# Couchsurfing

> A global peer-to-peer platform connecting travelers with local hosts for cultural exchange, community building, and affordable accommodation worldwide.

Couchsurfing enables millions of users to meet, stay with locals, and participate in community events across the globe. Founded by Casey Fenton and Daniel Hoffer, the platform emphasizes cultural exchange and social travel as core values, with robust safety guidelines and community-driven features.

## Key Topics

- peer-to-peer accommodation
- cultural exchange
- community-driven travel

- [Meet and Stay with Locals All Over the World | Couchsurfing](https://www.couchsurfing.com/welcome): Landing page introducing Couchsurfing's peer-to-peer travel and accommodation platform
- [How It Works | Couchsurfing](https://www.couchsurfing.com/about/how-it-works): Guide explaining Couchsurfing platform mechanics, hosting, and community features
- [About | Couchsurfing](https://about.couchsurfing.com/about/about-us): Company overview detailing Couchsurfing's mission, history, and founders

## Safety & Trust

- [Safety Basics | Couchsurfing](https://www.couchsurfing.com/about/safety): Safety guidelines and risk mitigation tips for Couchsurfing users and travelers

- [Couchsurfing Blog – Share Your Life](https://blog.couchsurfing.com): Travel guides, community stories, and hosting tips from Couchsurfing users
